item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: t-apron
  • 発売日: 2009-10-25
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シュレーディンガーの扉
  • 英語名: Schroedinger no Tobira

别名

  • The Schrodingers Door

あらすじ

Reina, my childhood girlfriend, and I were living in fulfilling school life.

Until that incident happened.

What happened to the precious childhood girlfriend.

Her heart was stolen for a moment.

Now she can not run away from this sexual pleasure.

While you didn’t know, her hidden sexual desire is being awaken.
